title: host.massremove
description: This method allows to simultaneously remove one or more related objects from all the given hosts.

groupids.description: Host groups to remove the hosts from.

ip.description: IP address used by the interface to identify it for removal.

dns.description: DNS name used by the interface to identify it for removal.

port.description: Port number used by the interface to identify it for removal.

interfaces.description: Interfaces to remove from the hosts, identified by matching ip, dns and port.

macros.description: Macros to remove from the hosts, given as macro names.

templateids.description: Templates to unlink from the hosts, keeping the items, triggers and graphs that belonged to it.

templateids_clear.description: Templates to unlink and clear from the hosts.
